observations: First error immediately schedules an authored new item within the six-person shift.
Second error displays that the new item was answered independently but incorrectly.
Third item displays independent correct on a different authored scene.
Normal subsequent correct answers do not reuse the preceding recheck relation.
Final result rows retain both recheck outcomes for the current round.
At 390px viewport, document width is 390px and no horizontal overflow was observed.

The successful-answer screenshot predates this wording correction. The completed-results screenshot does not show the superseded wording. coverage.interpretation: Offline all-unseen default first-shift scenarios without assignment restrictions. Not learner outcomes or coverage for every history/error combination.

limits: Source/target relation is explicit and held in the current game round; no durable linked intervention history was added.
Recheck is read-only and does not change first verdict, assistance status, learning aggregates, or recommendation policy.
Only complete available raw evidence may support a result. Folded/missing/unreadable history and closed WORLD runs cannot be silently treated as success.
Matching skill and difficulty alone does not prove the same underlying rule or concept, nor correction effectiveness.
Authored new items and explanations still need teacher review and student evaluation.
